caption: Let's work through this problem: Definite integral (FTC). First we'll see the idea, then every step, each one checked by a computer.
The definite integral adds up signed area under the curve between the limits.
Sum rule. Integrate term by term.
Constant multiple rule. Pull the constant 3 out of the integral.
Power rule. ∫ xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n + 1) with n = 2: raise the power by 1 and divide by the new power.
Integral of a constant. ∫ c dx = c·x.
Fundamental Theorem: F(b) − F(a). Evaluate F at the top limit 2 and subtract F at the bottom limit 0.
